blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Baguio Mayor Benjamin Magalong on Monday said the Pax Silica initiative needs a more comprehensive government information campaign. Speaking after this week’s flag-raising ceremony, the mayor said the absence of clear information has fueled speculation, misconceptions, and misinformation about the initiative. “Sa tingin ko na-identify na nila yung problema sa communication, ginagawan na nila ng paraan. So hintayin na lang siguro natin,” Magalong said. READ: Pax Silica brings promise – but at what cost? (I think the government has identified these gaps in communication and they are addressing them.
